'''Bobby Hilburn''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] player. At the [[2006 Dantooine Regional]] he and [[JW Millet]], who had come together from Stephenville, were the top two and split the prize money without playing a final confrontation.<ref name="pcf-10157-141541">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141541#141541 Dantooine Regionals June 10], aeneas23, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618002138/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141541 Internet Archive]</ref> Posting as Cyrusmorner and signing as Bobby Hilbun, a member of Team Stephenville, he proposed and planned the [[2008 Dantooine Regionals]] for 21 June 2008 at Game Domain in Stephenville, Texas.<ref name="sf-20909-302110">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302110#p302110 THE 2008 Dantooine Regionals Inquiry thread], Bobby Hilbun (Cyrusmorner), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 May 2008).</ref>
